contracts.geometry_rule: fresh R007 geometry renderer invocation with the R008 row dp; no R007 materialized Definition or control bytes reused
contracts.output_rule: TimeOut=T/64 or T/128 as predeclared per row; TimeMax is the inclusive observation-window end
contracts.q_rule: qualification uses reviewed 15-row matrix; production q_i=(i+0.5)/32, i=0..31
